text: In this modern, brightly lit space, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The glass walls and digital displays suggest innovation, while the R+D wall inside stimulates my philosophical mind—here, knowledge is created, tested, and shared. The vivid colors and overlapping patterns evoke thoughts about the interconnectedness of ideas and the ongoing journey of discovery. I am excited, yet reflective, as I ponder how such environments shape not only technology, but also the way we think and live together.
